<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This file is an Electron launcher/preload wrapper (`omofun.js`) typical of AUR `-bin` packages. It resolves the packaged app directory from `--app` argv, `/usr/lib/<name>`, or `_APPDIR`, then:

- Overrides `process.resourcesPath` to point to the packaged app dir (standard workaround for relocating Electron resources under `/usr/lib`).
- Forces `ELECTRON_IS_DEV=0` / `NODE_ENV=production` when it detects a packaged `.asar`/app directory, to avoid the app running in dev mode.
- Wraps a set of `fs` and `fs.promises` read/stat functions so that paths under Electron's bundled `resources/` directory are transparently redirected to the packaged app dir. The redirect is carefully scoped: it only affects paths with the `electronResources + path.sep` prefix, rejects any relative path containing `..`, and only rewrites when the first path component exists as a top-level entry of `appDir`.

There is no network activity (no `curl`/`wget`/http requests), no `eval`, no `base64`/hex/obfuscated payloads, no downloads, no credential or environment exfiltration, and no writes or deletions of unrelated system files. The fs monkey-patching is broad but strictly a path-relocation shim for this application's own resources, consistent with its stated packaging purpose. The only minor hygiene note is the use of a `@appname@` placeholder default that the packager must substitute; that is a build-time substitution concern, not malice.
</details>
<evidence>
</evidence>
<summary>Electron resource-path shim; no network, eval, obfuscation, or exfiltration. SAFE.</summary>
</security_assessment>
